gizmo.title: Mai kunna takardu
gizmo.description: Jagora, nuni da nassoshi don web component, tare da maɓallan kwafi don HTML, import, npm da CDN.

configure.title: Fayil ɗin bayanan takardu
configure.description: Bayanan takardun da ke zuwa tare da abin (lib/tag.docs.json).

configure.title: Allon labarin jagora
configure.description: Allon labarin motsi da ke zuwa tare da abin (tag.motion.json). Na zaɓi.

configure.title: Darasin bidiyo
configure.description: Gajeren bidiyo game da abin (YouTube, Vimeo ko fayil ɗin bidiyo). Yana maye gurbin bidiyon da ke cikin bayanan takardu.

configure.title: Buɗe a shafin
configure.description: Wane shafi ne ake nunawa da farko.

configure.title: Kunna jagora kai tsaye
configure.description: Fara jagorar da zarar mai kunnawa ya bayyana. Ana watsi da shi idan mai karatu ya fi son rage motsi.

advanced.title: Batun jagora
advanced.description: Don abubuwa masu jagorori da yawa, wane batu za a buɗe da farko (misali add-blocks). Bar shi babu komai don babban.

advanced.title: Mahaɗin nuni kai tsaye
advanced.description: Inda maɓallin Buɗe tushen nuni ke zuwa. A tsoho yana zuwa babban fayil ɗin demo a cikin rumbun.

advanced.title: Mahaɗin takardu
advanced.description: Inda maɓallin cikakkun takardu ke zuwa, misali shafin Learn HAX da ya dace.
